Challans under Rule 167 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Electronic means of Challans issued under sub-rule (1) or (2) of Rule 167 - Notification - Order
ORDER:
In the circumstances reported by the Transport Commissioner, Telangana in
his letter in the reference read above, the Government after careful examination
hereby decided to publish Notification, as required under Rule 167 of the Central
Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20th January, 2026
issued by the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India.
Accordingly, the following Notification shall be published in the Telangana
Gazette dated:02.06.2026.
NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-rule (3) of Rule 167 of the
Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, the Government of Telangana, with
immediate effect, hereby authorizes Short Messaging Services (SMS),
Whatsapp and e-mail, as electronic means of communication to serve the
challan issued, under sub-rule(1) or (2) of rule 167 of the said Rules. All vehicle
owners shall update their mobile number and e-mail address on Vahan portal
(http:/vahan.parivahan.gov.in) with in a period of one month from the date
of publication of this Notification, after expiry of said period, such challan
sent through Short Messaging Service (SMS) i.e., Whatsapp or e-mail, as the
case may be on mobile number or e-mail of vehicle owner recorded in the
Vahan Portal, shall be deemed to have served on the vehicle owner.
(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF TELANGANA)
VIKAS RAJ
SPECIAL CHIEF SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
To
The Commissioner of Printing Stationery & Stores Purchase (GNS).
Chanchalguda, Hyderabad. He is requested to publish the notification in the
Extra-Ordinary Issue of Telangana Gazette, dated and send 100 Copies to
Government.
The Transport Commissioner, Telangana, Hyderabad.
The Director General of Police, Telangana, Hyderabad.
The Commissioner of Police, Hyderabad.
The Commissioner of Police, Cyberabad.
The District Collector, Hyderabad.
The District Collector, Rangareddy.
The All Registering Authorities in the State (through Transport
Commissioner), TG, Hyderabad.
(P.T.O)
::2::
The Secretary to Government of India, Ministry of Road Transport &
Highways,
(Tr. Wing), New Delhi.
The Commissioner of information & Public Relations, Telangana, Hyderabad.
Copy to:
The Law Department.
The PS to Principal Secretary to C.M.
The OSD to Minister (Transport & BCW)
The P.S. to Special Chief Secretary to Government, TR&B Department.
SF/SCs.
//FORWARDED::BY ORDER//
SECTION OFFICER
